batch_wall_clock.includes: Preflight, fresh controls, coding and grading; excludes smoke checks and publication.

comparison_guidance: Match task IDs, model/effort, context/tool limits, execution policy, images and prompts before comparing rates. Do not merge this subset with the primary campaign.

comparison_reference.distinction: New draws explicitly request Fast; prior cohort had no explicit Fast override. Neither cohort establishes actual priority service for stock.

context.compaction_policy: Pinned bundled default; no threshold override.

execution_policy.conditional_continue: Final questions only; up to eight continuations within the same coding allowance.
execution_policy.testing_instruction: Do not add or run tests unless the user asks you to test or verify implementation.
execution_policy.verifier: Supplied project test scripts; no LLM judge used for these tasks.

limitations: Three draws per task/arm; sampling seed and temperature unavailable.
All cases were previously studied by the host; earlier implementations and feedback were not supplied to fresh actors.
Data-structure pytest validation is skipped by the supplied build on macOS.
Fast may be served at the default tier; stock response-tier capture is unavailable.
Three fresh draws per task do not isolate causal mechanisms or establish context-retention benefit.
privacy: Portable export contains metadata, scores and hashes; no auth files, raw request bodies, private binaries or absolute host paths.
scope: Independent repeated single-turn DeepSWE subset; separate from the primary 75-task campaign and earlier 25-task batch.

service_tier.note: Fast requested explicitly. Response-reported tiers are preserved; priority service is not assumed.
service_tier.stock_actual_served_tier: unknown: shipped harness has no HTTP body capture

verifier_controls.positive_control_source: Earlier frozen Wazero stock patch, isolated from all new actor contexts.
